div.p: A mainly residential suburb east of Essendon Airport and the Moonee Ponds Creek, and west of the railway line to Broadmeadows, Oak Park was originally part of John Pascoe Fawkner's estate. The suburb experienced rapid growth in the 1950s and 1960s.
